# CWO Strategy Group

> CWO Strategy Group, LLC is a small technology firm with team members in Dayton and Columbus, Ohio, serving businesses nationwide. It offers two services with equal focus: (1) CWO Vault private AI systems that run on hardware inside a client's business, and (2) website creation, website management (from $28/month) and SEO, AEO and GEO.

Contact: 614-965-4283 · cwostrategygroup@gmail.com · https://cwostrategy.com/start-a-project.html
Leadership: Michael Fitzpatrick (CEO & Co-Founder), Gino Prati (CFO), Michael Moloney (CTO).

## Services

- [Private AI systems (CWO Vault)](https://cwostrategy.com/private-ai.html): CWO supplies the hardware, installs open-weight AI models that run entirely on it, connects them to the client's files and finance workflows, trains the team and manages the system monthly. Data stays on the client's premises; the system can run offline; no per-seat fees. Built first for finance and accounting support (invoice and receipt reading, transaction categorization, month-end prep, questions answered from the company's own books), with a person approving all output. Systems: Vault Desk (teams of 1–10), Vault Office (10–50), Vault Rack (company-wide). Quoted after assessment. Currently accepting founding clients. CWO is not a CPA firm.
- [Websites](https://cwostrategy.com/websites.html): Custom, hand-coded websites (no WordPress or page builders), sub-second load times, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility. Website management from $28/month, month to month, 30 days' notice to cancel. SEO, AEO and GEO with plain-English monthly reports. Typical build: 2–5 weeks. No ranking guarantees.

## Key facts

- Locations: Dayton, Ohio and Columbus, Ohio; in-person service in both areas, remote service in all 50 states.
- Pricing: website management from $28/month; builds and private AI systems are fixed-price, written quotes after a free 30-minute call.
- Domains: CWO purchases and manages each client's domain (registration, renewals, DNS) for a hands-off experience; the client holds the rights to the domain and it is transferred to them if they leave.
- Principles: fixed written pricing, no long-term contracts, no ad trackers on client sites, client data stays with the client.

## FAQ

- **What does CWO Strategy Group do?** CWO Strategy Group is a small technology firm based in Dayton and Columbus, Ohio. We do two things: we install private AI systems that run on hardware inside your business, and we build, manage and optimize websites so customers find you on Google and in AI answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
- **What is a private AI system?** A private AI system is AI that runs on hardware you own, inside your office, instead of on a cloud service. Your documents and financial data stay in your building, there are no per-seat subscriptions, and it keeps working without an internet connection.
- **How much does website management cost?** Website management starts at $28 a month and scales with the size of the site and how often it changes. New websites and private AI systems are quoted in writing, at a fixed price, after a free 30-minute call.
- **Where are you located?** We're based in Dayton and Columbus, Ohio, and meet clients in person in both areas. We work with businesses in all 50 states by phone and video.
- **Do I have to sign a long-term contract?** No. Website management is month to month and can be cancelled with 30 days' notice. Every project is scoped and priced in writing before work begins.
- **Is private AI the same as using ChatGPT?** No. ChatGPT and similar tools run in a provider's data center, so your prompts and files travel there. Our systems run open-weight AI models on hardware in your building, set up for your workflows and connected to your own files and software.
- **Does my data ever leave my building?** Not for the AI work itself. Your documents, prompts and answers are processed on hardware in your office, on your network, and the system can run fully offline. If you want us to manage it remotely, that access is set up with your approval and can be switched off.
- **Can a private AI system do our accounting?** It can take a large share of the repetitive work off your team: reading invoices and receipts, drafting entries, categorizing transactions, flagging items that don't reconcile, and preparing reports. A person on your team reviews and approves the work before anything is final. It supports your bookkeeper or accountant rather than replacing them, and CWO Strategy Group is not a CPA firm.
- **What hardware do we get?** It depends on your team size and workload, from a single desktop AI workstation to a multi-GPU server or a rack-mounted system. We size it after an assessment, source it, install it, and you own it.
- **Which AI models do you use?** Open-weight models, meaning AI models that can be licensed to run on your own hardware, chosen for each job. We test them on your real tasks before rollout and upgrade them as better models are released.
- **How does private AI compare with ChatGPT or other cloud AI?** The largest cloud models are still stronger at open-ended, general-purpose tasks. Private AI makes more sense when privacy, predictable costs, offline operation and working directly with your own data matter more, which describes much of day-to-day business work. We'll tell you honestly which one fits.
- **How much does a private AI system cost?** Every system is quoted in writing after an assessment: hardware, installation and setup as a one-time cost, plus a flat monthly management plan. There are no per-seat fees. Founding clients receive founding pricing.
- **Do we need our own IT department?** No. We install the system, connect it to your files and software, train your team, and manage it afterwards. Your team uses it through a simple chat-style interface in a web browser.
- **Have you installed private AI for other businesses before?** Private AI is our newest service, and we're upfront about that. We've built and tested our setups on laptop-class hardware; client systems use the same approach on dedicated hardware sized for the job. That's why we're starting with a founding client program: a small number of businesses get founding pricing and direct access to the team building their system.
- **How much does a website cost?** Website management starts at $28 a month, depending on the size of the site and how often it changes. New builds and redesigns are quoted at a fixed price, in writing, after a free 30-minute call, and the price doesn't change unless you approve new work.
- **How long does it take to build a website?** Most small-business websites take two to five weeks from approved scope to launch. The biggest variable is how quickly we receive your content and approvals, not the build itself.
- **Do you use WordPress or website builders?** No. Every site is designed and hand-coded from scratch, with no themes, page builders or plugin sprawl. That's what keeps our sites fast, secure and easy to manage.
- **What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?** SEO (search engine optimization) helps your site rank on Google and Bing. AEO (answer engine optimization) structures your content so assistants and featured snippets can quote it directly. GEO (generative engine optimization) makes your business more likely to be cited and recommended by AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews.
- **Do you guarantee first-page rankings?** No. Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings. We commit to the technical work, the content and the structured data, and we show you every month what changed and what it did.
- **Who owns the website?** You do. On final payment, the custom code, design and content we create transfer to you. You also hold the rights to your domain. To keep things hands-off, we purchase and manage it for you, along with hosting, updates and security, so nothing breaks or expires. If you ever leave, we transfer it to you.
- **Do I need to buy my own domain?** No. We purchase your domain and manage it for you: registration, renewals and DNS settings are all handled, so you never have to log in to a registrar. The rights to the domain are yours, and we'll transfer it to you if you ever leave.
- **Can I cancel website management?** Yes. Management is month to month and can be cancelled with 30 days' notice. There are no long-term contracts.
- **Do you work with businesses outside Ohio?** Yes. We meet clients in person around Dayton and Columbus and work with businesses in all 50 states by phone and video.
